task: Fix the QA-found gap where the first Claude Code session after a proxy daemon port respawn still loses native OTel telemetry because the settings.json endpoint rewrite happens during SessionStart, after Claude Code's own OTel exporter has already initialized.

key_reasoning.reason: The ticket's own suggested fix direction (inject the OTLP endpoint into the codemie-claude launcher's spawn env) is directly contradicted by this codebase's recorded precedent (EPMCDME-10988): Claude Code's settings.json env block overrides spawn-time process env for exactly this variable family, and claude-code-otlp already declares OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT there. The native (unmanaged) launch path has no CodeMie-owned pre-spawn moment at all, so whether/how to cover it is an unresolved architectural decision, not a coding detail. No automated test can confirm the fix works against the real failure mode (Claude Code's own OTel SDK init timing) — only production verification can.

A viable fix likely spans the CLI/proxy layer (otlp-cold-start.ts's ensureOtlpProxy/refreshClaudeCodeOtlpEndpoint, already existing and tested) and the agent/adapter launcher layer (BaseAgentAdapter.ts / claude.plugin.ts beforeRun) if the fix is placed pre-spawn for managed launches, per the user's own framing that a base-adapter-level mechanism should be generic rather than claude-code-only. Touching BaseAgentAdapter — a shared class across all managed agent launches — is a core-shared-utility change even though it is reused, not newly built.

No exact precedent exists for resolving/writing the OTLP endpoint before Claude Code's own process startup (today's machinery is hook-time-only, run once per short-lived `codemie hook` process). A rollback plan is feasible (revert the new pre-spawn call site), but correctness is unverifiable by unit tests alone and rests on the same kind of production evidence QA already needed to surface this gap.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): fix likely touches BaseAgentAdapter.ts, a core shared utility used by every managed agent launch, even though via an existing, idempotent primitive (ensureOtlpProxy).

Requirements Clarity bumped from L (4) to XL (5): vague acceptance criteria / architectural decision unmade — the task's suggested fix direction is contradicted by existing codebase precedent, and whether/how to handle the native (unmanaged) launch path is undecided.
